text: Could you make this pic of me into a talking video where I say something about our sale? I always overthink these little sale messages, so I’d really appreciate having you handle the wording. You can write the line yourself, and somewhere in all of that I need it to be an 8-second square video with a friendly male English voice. Keep the message upbeat and mention our sale generally, without inventing any discounts, dates or products. I’m just hoping it feels welcoming rather than like I’m making a big fuss about it. Please don’t include any captions.
